page.layout: One manuscript leaf, verso, with no printed text. Left: a block of square-note plainchant on red five-line staves. Centre: a tall column of large Gothic decorated initials, running vertically. Upper right: a blue and red illuminated initial with red rubric capitals below it. Right edge: the binding, with a pencilled foliation "C85 v" at the top centre and a small pasted slip in the centre.
page.notes: This is a manuscript choir leaf, not a printed page, so it has no printed running text to transcribe. The large Gothic letters in the central column and the red rubric capitals are not legible enough to copy letter by letter, so I have not transcribed them. The pencilled foliation "C85 v" and the slip are handwriting or annotation, not printed matter, and are left out. The spine lettering at the far right edge is also not part of the page's text.
